content: Cyclic time based scheduling of BSW Main Functions Type: valid Description: The BSWMD template SHALL provide means to describe the cyclic time based scheduling requirements of BSW Main Functions. Rationale: The RTE Generator creates the scheduling for the whole ECU. Many BSW Modules rely on the cyclic time based call of their main functions in order to fulfill their functionality. The RTE Generator shall be able to implement the cyclic time based call based on the stated requirements. Dependencies:  Use Case: Call of the function "Com_MainFunctionTx()" from the generated RTE to achieve periodic sending of IPdus. Supporting Material: 
